matches.rationale: Findings 4 and 5 target Theorem 2.3 and its proof, and state precisely the ground-truth mechanism: the single scalar/bilinear-pairing condition pins down the conjugate only when the relevant Hodge piece has dimension ≤ 1, so the described order-2 construction fails to give complex conjugation when dim H^{i,n-1-i} ≥ 2.
